bloodbank.inventorySubtitle: Stock by group and component. Only units tested non-reactive with a confirmed group are available; expired and reactive units are discarded.
bloodbank.receiveUnitTitle: Receive a unit from another blood bank
bloodbank.donorsSubtitle: Register donors, screen them before every donation and collect the bag. Unfit donors are deferred with the reason and until-date.
bloodbank.crossmatchSubtitle: Requests from doctors and wards: group the patient’s sample, cross-match compatible units and reserve them. A second person verifies every cross-match.
bloodbank.issueSubtitle: Only reserved, verified, compatible and unexpired units go out, after the identity checklist. The ward records the transfusion, any reaction, and returns unused units in time.
bloodbank.sampleCheckNote: Check the tube label against the requisition (name, UHID, date and the collector’s signature) before grouping. A group that differs from the requisition or the patient’s record is refused.
bloodbank.noXmNeededNote: Plasma, platelets and cryo need no cross-match; the unit’s ABO / Rh is checked against the patient’s group.
bloodbank.previousReactionNote: The patient has had a transfusion reaction before.
bloodbank.bedsideCheckNote: Two people check at the bedside: the patient’s identity band against the compatibility label and the bag (name, UHID, unit number, group, expiry). Watch closely for the first 15 minutes.
bloodbank.reactionEmergencyNote: Stop the transfusion, keep the IV line open with normal saline, inform the doctor, and send the bag, the giving set and fresh blood and urine samples to the blood bank.
bloodbank.resultsFinalNote: Results are final once saved. The bag and its components are released to stock only when every test is non-reactive and the group is confirmed; anything reactive quarantines them and defers the donor.

unit.separateNote: Each component gets the bag number with a letter and its own expiry from the collection time. FFP, platelets and cryo only within the separation window ({{hours}} h).
unit.separationWindowPassed: The separation window has passed: only packed red cells can be made from this bag.
unit.quarantinedUntilApproved: The unit is quarantined until the blood bank officer approves the discard.
unit.disposalHint: Bio-medical waste rules: autoclave, then incineration (yellow bag).
unit.whyNotApproved: Why the discard is not approved
unit.expiredOnlyDiscard: Expired {{when}} — it can only be discarded.
unit.discardAskedNote: Discard asked by {{by}} ({{reason}}{{note}}), {{when}}. Waiting for the blood bank officer.
unit.inwardTestedLabelNote: Tested non-reactive by the sending blood bank; re-grouped here (label {{group}}).
unit.inwardTestedNote: Tested non-reactive by the sending blood bank; re-grouped here.
unit.sentForApproval: Sent to the blood bank officer for approval.
